name: io.github.basic-bit/soundiiz-mcp
description: MCP server for Soundiiz syncs and SmartLinks. Curated tools, auto-generated read/write layer from the OpenAPI spec, and confirmation-gated destructive operations.

environmentVariables.name: SOUNDIIZ_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Personal Soundiiz User API key. Generate at https://soundiiz.com/webapp/settings/api (requires Creator-plan subscription).

environmentVariables.name: SOUNDIIZ_MCP_KEY_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Where to read/persist the API key: env (default), file, or keychain (OS keychain via keytar).

environmentVariables.name: SOUNDIIZ_MCP_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Descriptive user agent sent to the Soundiiz API. Include contact info when possible.

environmentVariables.name: SOUNDIIZ_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to lock the server to GET-only mode. Defaults to true.

environmentVariables.name: SOUNDIIZ_MCP_CONFIRM_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to skip the confirmation-token flow on destructive operations. Defaults to true.
